First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow paced. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @nolasocialride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NOLA Social Ride Happy Thursday group ride

A slow cruise through a different part of New Orleans every Thursday, ending at a local bar. Bring speakers, lights and a smile; costumes are common. The website was down when checked, so use the Facebook group for the weekly start spot.
